episodes.description: Thwarted in their efforts to secure dates for the upcoming high school prom, Steve and Snot turn to the CIA's cloning machine to churn out two willing ladies. But, when the device produces two uber-fast-growing newborn babies, the boys must break out their fathering skills to ready them in time for prom night. Meanwhile, Stan takes home the CIA's cloned pet, Daren the Dodo, with disastrous consequences.

episodes.title: Poltergasm
episodes.description: Francine's "Poltergasm" starts to haunt the Smith household when she is unsatisfied by Stan in the sack, and Roger must conjure a medium named Zelda Rubinstein to help eliminate the ghost. Meanwhile, Hayley introduces her new boy-toy, Mauricio, to the family.

episodes.title: Buck, Wild
episodes.description: Steve is eager to prove that he's no longer a little boy, so he sets off to prove his manhood by joining Stan, Bullock and the rest of the CIA on their annual hunting trip. Meanwhile, Roger and Klaus set off on a cross-country road trip.

episodes.title: Crotchwalkers
episodes.description: In a desperate attempt to show Steve that she's still a "cool" mom, Francine teaches him a vast array of shoplifting techniques to try out at the local mall. B when their attempt to pull off the ultimate heist at "The Gash" goes awry, Steve is captured and sent to a Venezuelan sweatshop. Meanwhile, Roger, Hayley and Klaus form Langley Falls' first Russian Balalaika trio.

episodes.title: Kung Pao Turkey
episodes.description: Stan's plans for a perfect Thanksgiving watching football in his underwear are thwarted when Francine invites her adoptive parents to join them for the holiday. Meanwhile, Francine's mom encourages Hayley to get back on the dating scene and invites an eligible bachelor over, but her true intentions are revealed at Thanksgiving dinner.

episodes.title: Independent Movie
episodes.description: Determined to get Snot to confront his emotions after his father passes away, Steve and friends embark on an epic cross-country road trip to the funeral. But Steve's commitment to his friend wavers when he falls for a Pixie Dream Girl along the way. Meanwhile, Stan and Roger invent an automatic cake-cutter for the Home Shopping Network, but their partnership is tested when they only make a "verbal agreement" to split the profits.

episodes.title: Faking Bad
episodes.description: In this "Breaking Bad" parody, Hayley tries to fit in with a popular group of her former high school friends and, in the process, discovers Steve has an amazing ability to create incredibly realistic fake IDs. Sensing a business opportunity, Hayley builds out Steve's operation, but they don't count on having to deal with the other kingpin of the Langley Falls fake ID game: Kevin Ramage (Roger in disguise).

episodes.title: Minstrel Krampus
episodes.description: When Steve starts acting like a spoiled brat during the holidays, Stan takes him to see his incarcerated Grandpa Jack, who tells him the story of how he caught Minstrel Krampus, a legendary demon who punishes naughty children on Christmas. Stan decides that releasing Krampus is the only way to straighten out Steve's attitude. But when Krampus kidnaps Steve, it's up to Stan and Roger to get him back. Meanwhile, Hayley gets a job at the airport, but quickly realizes that she might not be cut out for customer service.

episodes.title: Vision: Impossible
episodes.description: Roger suffers a horrific car crash as he tries to take a picture of his crotch on a traffic speed cam. After waking up from a coma, he starts to have eerie visions of the future, and saves the Smiths from a terrible fire. But, Roger's abuse of his newfound powers soon draws the ire of his fellow family members and the Smiths must learn to cope with the uncertainty of the future.

episodes.title: Familyland
episodes.description: Francine is eager to re-live the Smith kids' childhood theme park adventures on a family visit to "Familyland." But, when the nefarious and cryogenically-frozen founder of the theme park, Roy Family, is mistakenly thawed, the Smiths find themselves prisoners of the medieval-themed park.

episodes.title: Cock of the Sleepwalk
episodes.description: Stan mixes up his nighttime routine after his 100th kill, but mistakenly unleashes a "good" Stan in his sleep - Jekyll & Hyde-style - who's hell-bent on pursuing all the good deeds that real Stan would never consider, and stopping him from ever killing again.

episodes.title: Introducing the Naughty Stewardesses
episodes.description: Roger and Steve switch faces in a scheme that has the former wooing an attractive girl for the latter, but things come to a head when Roger actually falls for the young lady. Meanwhile, Stan and Francine take to the sky as "Charlie's Angels"-type flight attendants to thwart a sinister scheme concocted by Mark Cuban.

episodes.title: I Ain't No Holodeck Boy
episodes.description: Against Francine's wishes, Stan takes the housebound kids into the woods for some outdoor playtime, where they wind up on the CIA's holodeck. Meanwhile, Hayley claims she is Roger's queen after purchasing his home star on an international star registry.

episodes.title: Stan Goes on the Pill
episodes.description: Stan turns into a "woman" after taking an experimental drug.

episodes.title: Honey, I'm Homeland
episodes.description: Stan attempts to infiltrate the "Occupy" movement, based on CIA intelligence that a leftist cell is planning a terrorist attack. But when he's captured and returned home by a group of radicals, Hayley suspects her father may have been "turned".

episodes.title: She Swill Survive
episodes.description: Stan fears that Hayley has no life skills, so he forces her to take a job as a bartender in Roger's attic haunt. However, when Bullock becomes Hayley's best customer, Stan realizes that he can use his daughter's knowledge to get ahead at work.

episodes.title: Rubberneckers
episodes.description: Stan's co-workers at the CIA teach him about "rubbernecking," the art of checking out other women on the sly, away from the gaze of their wives. But when Stan causes a massive accident in an attempt to take a picture of an attractive jogger, he's interviewed by an intimidating insurance inspector who may rat out Stan to Francine. Meanwhile, Roger and Klaus spill wine on the Smiths' brand new couch, and vow never to tell the other family members by sitting on the stained spot for the rest of their lives.

episodes.title: Permanent Record Wrecker
episodes.description: Stan is fired from the CIA in a round of budget cuts, but since his 20 years of work experience are classified and hidden from his "permanent record", the only job he's able to land is at the local grocery store where Steve is the manager. Meanwhile, Roger bets an annoying coffee shop musician that he can outplay him in one week. To accomplish his goal, he enters into a Faustian bargain with Lorenzo, a guitar-instructing infomercial host.

episodes.title: News Glance with Genevieve Vavance
episodes.description: Hayley starts an internship at a local news station working for a Nancy Grace-type reporter, who happens to be Roger in disguise. T.J. Miller, Nat Faxon and Josh Groban guest-voice.

episodes.title: The Longest Distance Relationship
episodes.description: A year after Jeff's abduction, Hayley is still heartbroken, until she meets Millionaire Matt Davis, who may be able to help her move forward. Things are going great, until Steve and Snot catch a signal on a CB radio - Jeff's alive in space and trying to make it back to Hayley.

episodes.title: Roger Passes the Bar
episodes.description: Roger is forced to sell his beloved attic bar to a restaurant chain after suffering a heart attack, and a sexy new next-door neighbor promises to take Steve and his friends' virginity in return for housework. Then, Roger movies in with Greg and Terry.

episodes.title: A Boy Named Michael
episodes.description: At a party celebrating Greg and Terry's adoption of a 10-year-old Russian boy, Roger gets a taste of their sophisticated lifestyle and decides to reject the Smiths and indoctrinate himself into his cultured neighbors' lives.

episodes.title: Blagsnarst, A Love Story
episodes.description: Roger and Francine discover an alien in the woods, and Roger capriciously has a one-night relationship with her before being fed up with her quirks. He tries to get rid of her by calling the CIA, but then realizes that he can't go through with it.

episodes.title: Blonde Ambition
episodes.description: When her efforts to save the planet prove hopeless, Hayley decides that she might get more attention if she becomes a blonde. Meanwhile, Stan and Steve go on a mission to find a new home for the Smiths.

episodes.title: CIAPOW
episodes.description: When Bullock sends a drone to do the job Stan and his colleagues are supposed to do, Stan is determined to prove that humans are better than robots. Meanwhile, Francine and the rest of the family participate in a slow motion race against each other in the living room.

episodes.title: Scents and Sensei-bility

episodes.description: Stan and Francine inject some much-needed fire into their relationship.

episodes.title: The Curious Case of the Old Hole
episodes.description: Wheels and the Legman try to hunt down the perpetrators who destroyed Steve's secret swimming hole. Meanwhile, Klaus helps an aging Principal Lewis reclaim his confidence.

episodes.title: Gold Top Nuts
episodes.description: The Smiths return from a difficult, quarrelsome vacation, but they can't get a break from each other.

episodes.title: The Three Fs
episodes.description: Francine's newfound friendship with a frog brings excitement to the whole Smith household; unfortunately, it drives their neighbor, Greg, crazy.

episodes.title: Smooshed: A Love Story
episodes.description: Steve goes on a class trip to Philadelphia, where he hopes to fall in love.

episodes.title: The Fast and the Spurious
episodes.description: Roger is forced to confront himself after a series of accidents; Klaus and Jeff bond.

episodes.title: A League of His Own
episodes.description: Steve profiles Stan for an essay contest at school; Francine uses a port-a-potty.

episodes.title: You Are Here
episodes.description: Roger and Steve try to save a dying mall.

episodes.title: I Heard You Wanna Buy Some Speakers
episodes.description: Barry blows out his dad's speakers and Snot helps him replace them. Stan attempts to do a standing backflip.

episodes.title: Hayley Was a Girl Scout?
episodes.description: Stan is forced to co-lead a scouts troop with Hayley while Steve blunders in his fantasy world.

episodes.title: Please Please Jeff
episodes.description: Jeff's people pleasing nature gets in the way of his relationship with Hayley; Stan wears a confusing costume to the CIA costume party.

episodes.title: Jambalaya
episodes.description: Francine successfully grows a garden, which reminds Roger that he has a recipe for truly authentic jambalaya.

episodes.title: Gernot and Strudel
episodes.description: Hoping to teach him the value of sharing, the family recreates a television show from Klaus' childhood. Roger has a piano recital.

episodes.title: Echoes
episodes.description: Steve starts a work-study program and discovers that not all is what it seems at Channel 3 News. Roger seeks redemption in the Nashville country music scene.

episodes.title: The Grounch
episodes.description: When Roger has his famous Christmas sex party stolen from him the results are...monstrous. Stan creates a magazine for men.

episodes.title: Fellow Traveler
episodes.description: A lunar misstep sends Roger on an unexpected detour to New Mexico.

episodes.title: The Professor and the Coach
episodes.description: Hayley tries to help Roger write a book.

episodes.title: Viced Principal
episodes.description: Steve and Principal Lewis get caught in a dangerous situation at the school; the rest of the family make an adorable new friend.

episodes.title: The Pleasanting at Smith House
episodes.description: Klaus and Jeff's friendship is threatened by Klaus' girlfriend from another realm.

episodes.title: Stretched Thin
episodes.description: When Jeff finds out that the family thinks he makes terrible decisions, he decides to take a job selling stretchy leggings to prove them wrong.

episodes.title: Better on Paper
episodes.description: When Stan discovers anonymous love letters written to Francine, he worries that this secret admirer could threaten their relationship.

episodes.title: Cow I Met Your Moo-ther
episodes.description: The judgmental voice in Hayley's head makes it impossible for her to enjoy a girls' night with Nerfer and Danuta.

episodes.title: Stan Fixes a Shingle
episodes.description: Francine insists that Steve let her help with his school project, Stan finally fixes that shingle, and the rest of the family goes on a quest to return Gallagher's mallet.

episodes.title: Saving Face
episodes.description: In an attempt to maintain his "prime," Stan explores some cosmetic solutions that could not go worse.

episodes.title: Frantastic Voyage
episodes.description: When Stan goes too far to keep his work friend away from Francine, she is forced to save her new "little" friend.

episodes.title: A Little Mystery
episodes.description: Hayley makes Jeff get a friend to add some mystery to their relationship but gets more mystery than she bargained for; Francine attempts to grow the world's longest fingernails.

episodes.title: Don't You Be My Neighbor
episodes.description: The Smiths get new neighbors; Roger dreads having to be a little boy's kite for a day.

episodes.title: Productive Panic
episodes.description: Francine becomes an overnight sensation when a famous art dealer discovers her homemade pottery.

episodes.title: Multiverse of American Dadness
episodes.description: Hayley searches for a runaway Steve so they can go to a Shaggy concert.

episodes.title: Z.O.I.N.C.S.
episodes.description: It's Halloween night and Stan is missing, so the Smith gang heads to the spooky, abandoned CIA headquarters to investigate.

episodes.title: A New Era for the Smith House
episodes.description: Klaus house sits for the Smiths while they are away on vacation; Roger investigates the origin of powerful winds plaguing the Eastern Seaboard.

episodes.title: Between a Ring and a Hardass
episodes.description: Social Services threatens to take Steve away from the family when someone files a complaint about Steve's chaotic home life.

episodes.title: Footprints
episodes.description: Stan and Roger go on a mission to leave their mark on humanity. Jeff finally deals with the reality of losing his signature hat.

episodes.title: Steve, Snot, and the Quest for the Og 4LOCO
episodes.description: In order to have a chance with a girl, Steve and Snot must track down a keg of 4Loko.

episodes.title: The Pink Sphinx Holds Her Hearts on the Turn
episodes.description: Francine enters the strange and dangerous world of poker in order to learn how to hide her true feelings from Steve and Hayley.

episodes.title: A Little Extra Scratch
episodes.description: Suspicious about Hayley's mysterious, newfound wealth, Francine decides to get to the bottom of it. Roger sets out to make Stan an internet celebrity.

episodes.title: Into the Jingleverse
episodes.description: When Steve gives the family better Christmas gifts than Stan, Stan goes to great lengths to regain his title of "King of Presents."

episodes.title: The Grocery Store Bank
episodes.description: Stan, Francine and Roger concoct the perfect plan to rob a bank but agree never to do it. Peace reigns.

episodes.title: Brown Lotus
episodes.description: Hayley and Jeff take a staycation at a nearby luxury resort, while the CIA is forced to rebrand.

episodes.title: I've Got a Friend in Me
episodes.description: After a freak accident, Stan and Roger end up stuck together in the worst possible way. Klaus contends with an impostor.

episodes.title: Touch the Sun: A Chimborazo Adventure
episodes.description: The family's dream of climbing Mount Everest turns into a nightmare when Stan tries to save a buck and takes them to a different, much cheaper mountain.

episodes.title: Under (and Over, and Beside) the Boardwalk
episodes.description: The Smiths are overjoyed when the Langley Falls boardwalk reopens.

episodes.title: The Violence of the Clams
episodes.description: Steve feels isolated when he dislikes a new fast food restaurant popular among his friends; Stan and Francine attempt to return misdelivered mail.

episodes.title: An Adult Woman
episodes.description: After Hayley is deemed a big child by The Lady from The Hamster Rescue Society, she gets involved with two Roger personas who have a complicated family dynamic in an effort to prove that she is an adult woman.

episodes.title: Piece by Piece
episodes.description: After a nearly fatal interaction with one of Roger's personas, Steve and Stan work together to uncover the persona's mysterious past. Meanwhile, Jeff, Hayley and Francine explore new hobbies.

episodes.title: Nasty Christmas
episodes.description: Bullock throws a private, star-studded Christmas party the exact same night as the CIA work party. Stan and Klaus are determined to get in, by any means necessary.

episodes.title: Idiot Rich
episodes.description: Jeff gets a job after the family calls him out for being a mooch. When he unexpectedly strikes it rich, Hayley must protect Jeff from the family's greed.

episodes.title: Killer Mimosa
episodes.description: Hayley scores an internship at Morning Mimosa but finds herself on thin ice when she tries to inject real journalism into the show. Meanwhile, the rest of the family suffers through a ravaging case of food poisoning.

episodes.title: The Legend of Mike Madonia, the Rototiller Man
episodes.description: Francine joins Tuttle's gardening club, but he wants her gone; the rest of the family practice the power of yes.

episodes.title: The Clearview Motel
episodes.description: Francine and Roger become addicted to peeping in on people at a mysterious motel.

episodes.title: The Girl Who Cried Space Jam
episodes.description: Forces of evil beyond human comprehension bully Hayley into doing a Space Jam.

episodes.title: Get Him to the Greek Life Style
episodes.description: Stan attempts to live forever in order to do everything on his bucket list.

episodes.title: The Mystery of the Missing Bazooka Shark Babe
episodes.description: After Danuta goes missing, Hayley joins forces with Wheels and The Legman detective to investigate the Bazooka Shark Babes' involvement in her friend's mysterious disappearance.

episodes.title: Pork 'N Feelings
episodes.description: To save their marriage, Jeff needs Hayley to open up more to him, but she wants no part in it.

episodes.title: Oh Brothel, Where Art Thou?
episodes.description: After Greg receives a plaque from the local historical society, Stan goes to great lengths to get the same honor. Roger becomes a traveling salesman.

episodes.title: The Sickness
episodes.description: When Rogu comes down with a mysterious illness, the Smiths struggle to find a cure.

episodes.title: Silicon Steve
episodes.description: Steve spends his summer working on an app with some unlikely friends, while the rest of the family become cord-cutters.

episodes.title: Guardian
episodes.description: Stan uses a mothballed military computer to do Steve's math homework, starting the clock toward nuclear annihilation.

episodes.title: What Great Advancements!
episodes.description: An aspiring inventor leaves the Farm to make a go of it in The Big City.

episodes.title: Aw Rats, A Pool Party
episodes.description: The Smiths are having a pool party! Everyone is coming, including Francine's sister and Steve's ex! Wait, is that a dead rat in the pool?.

episodes.title: The Flume Flume Room
episodes.description: Stan struggles to appreciate Francine's niche interest in flume rides.

episodes.title: Powering Through
episodes.description: Stan is determined to prove that there's no illness he can't power through, even if it ends up killing him.. and everyone else.

episodes.title: Camera Stan
episodes.description: Stan thinks he has what it takes to thrive on reality TV; Klaus gets himself a Klaus.

episodes.title: Idol Threat
episodes.description: The school bully saves Steve's life at the carnival and is celebrated as a local hero by everyone but Steve.

episodes.title: The Treasure of Old Chinatown
episodes.description: Steve and Bah Bah, along with a reluctant Francine, set out to discover an ancient Chinese treasure. Roger becomes an online food influencer.

episodes.title: Reaper Madness
episodes.description: After experiencing a euphoric high from a scary story, Klaus and Hayley band together to search for their next fix.

episodes.title: Dude, You're Getting a Del!
episodes.description: Klaus becomes Snot's father figure to woo Snot's mom. Meanwhile, Hayley opens a cat café and hires Roger's infamous cat persona, Marmalade.

episodes.title: Where the Wild Boars Are
episodes.description: Jeff comes of age with the help of an old man. Roger takes care of a "special" shed.

episodes.title: Dumbston Checks In
episodes.description: Steve and Principal Lewis team up to save the school while Stan seeks out a decent meal.

episodes.title: A Donkey's Shame
episodes.description: Stan and Francine drive to Vegas to confront John Mayer.
Stan nearly dies on his 400th mission and returns home to realize the CIA's secret clone program has already replaced him.

episodes.title: Tales from the Outer Frontier
episodes.description: In this three-part anthology of self-contained tales, the Smiths take on new roles across the harsh frontier of space, confronting mortality, purpose, and that relentless Mars dust.

tt0121955.title: South Park
tt0121955.description: South Park is an adult comedy animation show centred around 4 children in the small town of south park. Its humour is often dark involving satirical elements and mocking current real-life events.

episodes.title: Cartman Gets an Anal Probe
episodes.description: Aliens wreak havoc in the Rockies, first by subjecting Cartman to an anal probe, and then by abducting Kyle's baby brother.

episodes.title: Weight Gain 4000
episodes.description: Cartman tries to slim down when he learns a TV talk-show host is coming to town to give him an award, but he bulks up instead. Meanwhile, Mr. Garrison hatches a plan to murder the visiting celeb.

episodes.title: Volcano
episodes.description: A volcanic eruption interrupts the boys' camping trip.

episodes.title: Big Gay Al's Big Gay Boat Ride
episodes.description: When his pup explores his sexuality, Stan gets so upset that he inadvertently threatens to blow the school's homecoming-game victory.

episodes.title: An Elephant Makes Love to a Pig
episodes.description: After a botched genetic experiment, Stan's clone is let loose in the town. Voices include Trey Parker and Matt Stone.

episodes.title: Death
episodes.description: The boys summon the Grim Reaper.

episodes.title: Pinkeye
episodes.description: A pinkeye epidemic interrupts the boys' plans to win a Halloween-costume contest; and Kenny has a run-in with a Russian space station when it falls to Earth.

episodes.title: Starvin' Marvin
episodes.description: After the boys contact an agency that helps starving children, Government authorities send Cartman to Ethiopia. Meanwhile, the town holds a drive for canned goods; and turkeys revolt against a genetic engineer.

episodes.title: Mr. Hankey, the Christmas Poo
episodes.description: Because he's Jewish, Kyle is denied involvement in the Nativity play and excluded from trips to see Santa. Meanwhile, South Park residents try to plan a politically correct celebration; and Mr. Hankey visits Kyle.

episodes.title: Damien
episodes.description: As Cartman celebrates his birthday, Jesus Christ and Satan duke it out on a pay-per-view TV special. Meanwhile, Satan's son Damien tries to fit in with the crowd after making a violent first impression.

episodes.title: Tom's Rhinoplasty
episodes.description: Mr. Garrison takes a leave of absence to have a nose job and is replaced by Miss Ellen, a substitute who threatens Stan and Wendy's relationship.

episodes.title: Mecha-Streisand
episodes.description: The future of the world is at stake after the boys unearth a prehistoric relic that spawns a monster.

episodes.title: Cartman's Mom is a Dirty Slut
episodes.description: When Cartman begins to exhibit odd behavior, a counselor suggests that finding his father may solve his problems.

episodes.title: Terrance & Phillip in "Not Without My Anus"
episodes.description: An episode featuring Terrance and Phillip, who must save Canada from Saddam Hussein.

episodes.title: Cartman's Mom Is Still a Dirty Slut
episodes.description: Chef and the boys rush to the hospital to check on Mephesto, who's gunned down just as he's set to reveal the identity of Cartman's father. Meanwhile, the townspeople search for the gunman and battle a snowstorm.

episodes.title: Chickenlover
episodes.description: Chaos ensues on the streets of South Park as the town is overcome by a crime wave that leaves scores of chickens assaulted. And Officer Barbrady's no help...because he's resigned.

episodes.title: Ike's Wee Wee
episodes.description: The boys try to circumvent a delicate surgical procedure set to be performed on Kyle's brother as part of a tradition begun by their Jewish ancestors. Meanwhile, Mr. Mackey is cut from his job after he botches a lecture on drugs.

episodes.title: Conjoined Fetus Lady
episodes.description: Kyle's terrified after an injury sustained during a dodgeball game sends him to the nurse---a conjoined twin with an unusual medical condition. Meanwhile, Pip leads the dodgeball team to the world championships in China.

episodes.title: The Mexican Staring Frog of Southern Sri Lanka
episodes.description: Jimbo and Ned launch a TV hunting show, which goes head-to-head with "Jesus and Pals," the popular cable-access series.

episodes.title: City on the Edge of Forever
episodes.description: The boys put twists on events such as the attempted assassination of a talk-show host and a fight with Death as their bus hangs off a cliff. Meanwhile, Ms. Crabtree finds fame when she goes to look for help.

episodes.title: Summer Sucks
episodes.description: The mayor devises a plan to make the town's Fourth of July celebration memorable, despite a ban on fireworks; and Mr. Hat vanishes, causing Mr. Garrison to visit a therapist.

episodes.title: Chef's Chocolate Salty Balls
episodes.description: Hollywood pooh-bahs in town for a film festival try to sign Mr. Hankey to a movie deal after their upscale cuisine disrupts the sewage system and nearly destroys him. Meanwhile, locals are up in arms over the movie-industry event.

episodes.title: Chickenpox
episodes.description: The town faces an outbreak of chicken pox.

episodes.title: Roger Ebert Should Lay Off the Fatty Foods
episodes.description: Stan, Kyle and Kenny gravitate toward a new planetarium; and Cartman auditions to be the star of "Les Miserables."

episodes.title: Clubhouses
episodes.description: The boys each build a clubhouse---and Stan is eager to have Wendy over for a game of "truth or dare." However, his parents' separation interferes with his plans.

episodes.title: Cow Days
episodes.description: During South Park's annual rodeo, the boys compete in a bull-riding contest. Meanwhile, the cows find religion.

episodes.title: Chef Aid
episodes.description: Chef invites some of his well-known musician friends to participate in a benefit concert after he loses all of his money in a lawsuit. Meanwhile, the boys join the workforce to help him get out of debt.

episodes.title: Spooky Fish
episodes.description: Stan fears his pet fish may be involved with a rash of unsolved murders that occur on Halloween. Meanwhile, Cartman starts killing people---with kindness, even going so far as to appreciate Wendy's liberal views.

episodes.title: Merry Christmas Charlie Manson!
episodes.description: The boys go to Cartman's grandmother's house for a holiday feast that's also attended by Cartman's uncle (an escaped con) and the police.

episodes.title: Gnomes (a.k.a. Underpants Gnomes)
episodes.description: The boys work on a project with a high-strung kid whose parents' coffee shop faces strong competition from a conglomerate that hopes to set up in South Park.

episodes.title: Prehistoric Ice Man
episodes.description: The boys unearth a prehistoric man frozen in ice, but the discovery jeopardizes Stan and Kyle's friendship when they argue over what to name him.

episodes.title: Rainforest Schmainforest
episodes.description: The boys accompany a teacher and her singing-and-dancing group to Central America to raise awareness of the rain forest. Also: Kenny falls for a choir member; and Kyle has trouble mastering the choreography.

episodes.title: Spontaneous Combustion
episodes.description: Residents start to spontaneously combust, prompting Stan's geologist father to investigate.

episodes.title: The Succubus (a.k.a. Chef's Mama)
episodes.description: Chef gets a visit from his mother when the boys feel his bride-to-be has taken their place in his heart.

episodes.title: Jakovasaurs
episodes.description: The boys discover two nearly extinct animals while camping on the banks of Stark's Pond.

episodes.title: Tweek vs. Craig
episodes.description: The boys take a shop class taught by an eccentric, and urge a schoolyard fight between classmates Tweek and Craig.

episodes.title: Sexual Harassment Panda
episodes.description: Cartman sues Stan for sexual harassment.

episodes.title: Cat Orgy
episodes.description: Shelly baby-sits Cartman.

episodes.title: Two Guys Naked in a Hot Tub
episodes.description: A meteor shower hits town, and Stan's sister Shelly babysits Cartman while Mrs. Cartman goes to a "meteor party."

episodes.title: Jewbilee
episodes.description: Kyle and Ike go on a camping trip while South Park residents wait for a meteor shower to begin.

episodes.title: Korn's Groovy Pirate Ghost Mystery
episodes.description: On Halloween, the boys are plagued by fifth graders and the town is overrun by pirate ghosts. Music group Korn assists, and sings "Falling Away from Me."

episodes.title: Chinpokomon
episodes.description: Adults try to counter when the town's children become obsessed with a fad from Japan, whose government reveals their master plan behind the craze.

episodes.title: Hooked on Monkey Fonics
episodes.description: Kyle tries to teach his new rival about love; the boys compete against home-schooled kids in the annual spelling bee; and Cartman's mom agrees to teach him at home.

episodes.title: Starvin' Marvin in Space!
episodes.description: Starvin Marvin returns in a stolen U.S. spaceship, and enlists the boys to help feed his Ethiopian village. The CIA is among their pursuers.

episodes.title: The Red Badge of Gayness (a.k.a. War)
episodes.description: The town holds its annual reenactment of a Civil War battle, and Cartman suits up for the Confederacy with visions of glory.

episodes.title: Mr. Hankey's Christmas Classics
episodes.description: Mr. Hankey and South Park citizens celebrate the holidays with musical numbers from his Christmas Classics Album.

episodes.title: Are You There God, It's Me Jesus
episodes.description: "Are You There, God? It's Me, Jesus" purports to "answer age-old questions about who we are and what we're all about."

episodes.title: Worldwide Recorder Concert (a.k.a. The Brown Noise)
episodes.description: The boys and their class travel to the first "Worldwide Recorder Concert" in Arkansas, where Mr. Garrison confronts the demons of his childhood while visiting his parents.

episodes.title: The Tooth Fairy's TATS 2000
episodes.description: Cartman impersonates the Tooth Fairy when he learns there's money to be made from harvesting the teeth of underprivileged kids. However, the leader of a dentists' organization sets out to stop him.

episodes.title: Cartman's Silly Hate Crime 2000
episodes.description: Cartman is sentenced to juvenile hall and his friends plan to get him out. Meanwhile, he begins to adjust to life on the inside.

episodes.title: Timmy! 2000
episodes.description: Mr. Mackey excuses Timmy from homework when he mistakenly thinks the boy is suffering from Attention Deficit Disorder; then Cartman and his friends try to develop the same affliction.

episodes.title: Quintuplets 2000
episodes.description: The South Park media showers attention on a family with quintuplets that moves into the area, and Cartman befriends one of the new residents. Meanwhile, Kenny's mom tries to cash in on the excitement by planning a multiple birth of her own.

episodes.title: Cartman Joins NAMBLA
episodes.description: Cartman seeks online companionship from older users after deciding that Stan, Kenny and Kyle aren't mature enough.

episodes.title: Cherokee Hair Tampons
episodes.description: Kyle suffers from a rare kidney disease and Cartman may be the only one who can save him, but at a high price.

episodes.title: Chef Goes Nanners
episodes.description: Chef protests against the South Park flag and ignites a town debate that even divides the kids. Meanwhile, Wendy becomes attracted to Cartman.

episodes.title: Something You Can Do with Your Finger (a.k.a. Fingerbang)
episodes.description: Stan, Kyle, Kenny and Cartman form their own band and hold tryouts for a fifth member.

episodes.title: Do the Handicapped Go to Hell? (1)
episodes.description: The boys, scared by Priest Maxi's threats of eternal damnation, scramble to take part in Holy Communion and their first Confession in order to "save" themselves.

episodes.title: Probably (2)
episodes.description: Satan can't decide between his new boyfriend and his former beau, Saddam Hussein. Meanwhile, Cartman has discovered his evangelical side and tries to ensure the gang a passage to heaven.

episodes.title: Fourth Grade
episodes.description: The fearful boys speculate on the identity of their teacher as they begin the fourth grade, leading them to build a time machine to take them back to the safety of third grade.

episodes.title: Trapper Keeper
episodes.description: Mr. Garrison orders a recount when the race for kindergarten president is too close to call. Meanwhile, a life form from the future appears in the school yard at South Park Elementary.

episodes.title: Helen Keller! The Musical
episodes.description: The boys work on a Thanksgiving pageant about Helen Keller and decide to use a turkey instead of a dog.

episodes.title: Pip (a.k.a. Great Expectations)
episodes.description: The boys' British classmate, Pip, stars in this spoof of Dickens' classic "Great Expectations," set in London.

episodes.title: Fat Camp
episodes.description: Cartman is sent to a camp for obese youngsters by concerned family and friends. Meanwhile, Kenny has his own hit TV show, "Krazy Kenny." Also, Chef talks to the boys about prostitution.

episodes.title: The Wacky Molestation Adventure
episodes.description: Cartman becomes South Park's mayor when the kids take over the town.

episodes.title: A Very Crappy Christmas
episodes.description: The boys make a video Christmas card when Mr. Hankey's visit is delayed.

episodes.title: It Hits the Fan
episodes.description: The boys realize they may have made history of some sort when Cartman utters an expletive.

episodes.title: Cripple Fight
episodes.description: The boys join the Mountain Scouts with Timmy, who winds up in a fight with Jimmy in a supermarket parking lot.

episodes.title: Super Best Friends
episodes.description: A magician persuades Kenny, Cartman and Kyle to join his cult, and their journey lands them in Washington, D.C.

episodes.title: Scott Tenorman Must Die
episodes.description: Radiohead plays a role in Cartman's plan for revenge against an eighth-grader who wronged him.

episodes.title: Terrance and Phillip: Behind the Blow
episodes.description: The boys are devastated to learn that their heroes Terrence and Phillip have broken up.

episodes.title: Cartmanland
episodes.description: Cartman uses his $1 million inheritance to open his own amusement park.

episodes.title: Proper Condom Use
episodes.description: The impulsive implementation of sex-education classes at school leads to an all-out battle between the boys and the girls.

episodes.title: Towelie
episodes.description: The gang tries to protect a new resident in South Park from the government.

episodes.title: Osama Bin Laden Has Farty Pants
episodes.description: The boys decide to get into the patriotic spirit by heeding the President's advice to send money to the children of Afghanistan. But their spirits sour when they receive a package back and their mail becomes the focus of Government investigators.

episodes.title: How to Eat with Your Butt
episodes.description: As a prank, Cartman somehow gets Kenny's picture pasted on milk cartons as a missing child, which soon backfires on him.

episodes.title: The Entity (a.k.a. The Ginger Device)
episodes.description: Kyle is embarrassed by his cousin, Kyle, and tries to think of ways to avoid him in front of his friends.

episodes.title: Here Comes the Neighborhood
episodes.description: Kyle, Stan, Kenny and Cartman have a run-in with Token, the town's only rich kid. In retaliation, Token encourages other wealthy people to move into the neighborhood.

episodes.title: Kenny Dies
episodes.description: Cartman discovers the benefits of stem-cell research.

episodes.title: Butters' Very Own Episode
episodes.description: Butters looks forward to his parents' anniversary dinner despite his mother's reaction to his father's secret extracurricular activities.

episodes.title: Jared Has Aides
episodes.description: The gang seizes upon an opportunity to make money with a weight-loss program that's sweeping the country.

episodes.title: Asspen
episodes.description: The boys head to Aspen, where the slopes are superb and Stan gets into a showdown with the lodge's expert skier.

episodes.title: Freak Strike
episodes.description: The gang decides to put Butters up as a guest on a talk show thinking that they will get special favors.

episodes.title: Fun with Veal
episodes.description: After learning how veal is made, the boys try to save some calves from the slaughterhouse.

episodes.title: The New Terrance and Phillip Movie Trailer
episodes.description: The boys look forward to the newest Terrance and Phillip movie.

episodes.title: Professor Chaos
episodes.description: When Butters is rejected by the kids, his alter ego Professor Chaos is unleashed.

episodes.title: The Simpsons Already Did It
episodes.description: Cartman and the gang fear that they may have accidentally caused a death.

episodes.title: Red Hot Catholic Love
episodes.description: A priest visits South Park to find out why church attendance is down; the boys protest the tinkering of their favorite movies.

episodes.title: Free Hat
episodes.description: The boys try to prevent filmmakers from remaking their movies, but their efforts are mistaken for a campaign for the release of an infamous criminal.

episodes.title: Bebe's Boobs Destroy Society
episodes.description: When Bebe starts to mature physically, the boys behave so boorishly that their friendships are almost ruined.

episodes.title: Child Abduction is Not Funny
episodes.description: Media stories about kidnappings drive South Park parents to extreme measures, such as building a wall around the town to keep out predators.

episodes.title: A Ladder to Heaven
episodes.description: Trying to find Kenny in Heaven, the boys discover that Saddam Hussein may have hidden weapons there.

episodes.title: The Return of the Fellowship of the Ring to the Two Towers
episodes.description: While returning "The Lord of the Rings" to the video store, the boys accidentally get a hold of a steamy porno tape.

episodes.title: Death Camp of Tolerance
episodes.description: The boys are sent to a camp where cultural sensitivity is taught.

episodes.title: Stanley's Cup
episodes.description: Stan Marsh has hit rock bottom. He's got no job, no bicycle and his only way out of a bad situation is to coach the local pee wee hockey team. Once a hotshot pee wee hockey player himself, Marsh has tried to put those days behind him. But he's still living with the memory of how he let his team down when he missed the winning shot in the big game. Now, he's about to find out that being a coach means facing your past. He's determined to show his kids what it's like to be winners!

The identity of Cartman's dad is on everyone's mind despite threats from the ginger kids about Muhammad and enraged celebrities who have harnessed the power of Mecha Streisand.

episodes.title: Jewpacabra
episodes.description: The town's Easter-egg hunt may be canceled due to rumors of a vicious beast that Cartman claims to have caught on film.

episodes.description: A romance for Cartman may finally become a reality when there's a new girl at school.

episodes.title: Sarcastaball
episodes.description: Randy's campaign to prevent head injuries in football radically changes the way the game is played, but the new rules become a national sensation and even make a South Park student a star athlete.

episodes.description: Kyle suspects that his mother is having an affair with a deliveryman; Cartman installs a home-security system.

episodes.description: When Butters starts acting out at school, his parents realize it's time to tell him why he's not like all of the other kids. He must travel to a foreign place to learn the ways of his people. It will be a difficult trip for a young boy to make alone, so Butters chooses Kenny to travel with him to the distant and secluded island of Hawaii.

episodes.description: An icon is implicated in a doping scandal, so supporters start cutting off their symbolic wristbands.

episodes.description: In the series 16 finale, Cartman believes he can affect the outcome of the 2012 presidential election.

episodes.description: Ike just isn't himself lately and he and Kyle are growing apart. Kyle goes to the guidance counselor for advice, but Mr. Mackey is too busy dealing with the bugs in the school's new integrated technology system to help. Kyle decides to take Ike to a live performance of his favorite show, "Yo Gabba Gabba!" He hopes it'll make his little brother like him again.

episodes.title: Ginger Cow

episodes.title: Go Fund Yourself

episodes.title: Gluten Free Ebola

episodes.description: Stan is searching for answers about how a person who he's always known to be one thing could suddenly identify with another. In the meantime, the pressure of holding on to a giant secret is starting to get to Randy.

episodes.description: Handicapped driven vehicles compete with taxi's and other vehicles. The company entitled "Handicar" with the lead driver being Timmy.

episodes.title: Freemium Isn't Free
episodes.description: Stan's addicted to a new app marketed by Terrance and Phillip, but the duo find that all the money they're making can't buy happiness.

episodes.description: Butters is convinced that he's living in a virtual reality. When he suddenly goes rogue and wreaks havoc at home and all over South Park, everyone struggles to figure out what's real.

episodes.description: Kenny excels at playing the game, Magic: The Gathering. He has the boys' full attention until a new, hard-core activity gets in the way. When Wendy tries to get Stan to pay attention to what she's doing, she realizes that what he does with his guy friends always comes first.

episodes.title: #rehash
episodes.description: Randy's forced to perform again after Stan spends all the Marsh's money on freemium games; Kyle gets upset when Ike doesn't want to play with him anymore.

episodes.title: #HappyHolograms

episodes.title: Where My Country Gone?
episodes.description: Tired of illegal immigrants continuously crossing over the border into the United States without any repercussions, Mr. Garrison wants a wall to be built to keep them out of the country.

episodes.title: The City Part of Town
episodes.description: Kenny tries to land a job when the town of South Park begins gentrifying.

episodes.title: You're Not Yelping

Being the crack reporter that he is, Jimmy sets out to learn everything he can about what makes Leslie tick. Meanwhile, Principal Victoria and Mr. Garrison return to a South Park that has become unrecognizable

episodes.title: PC Principal Final Justice

episodes.title: Douche and a Danish
episodes.description: Garrison finally goes too far at a rally and reconsiders his future in politics. Meanwhile, the kids begin searching for an infamous Internet troll; and Gerald joins the opposition to a Danish campaign tracking nefarious characters on the Web.

episodes.title: Fort Collins

episodes.title: Oh Jeez

episodes.title: Holiday Special
episodes.description: Everyone is going crazy as Columbus Day gets canceled and the kids try to bring it back as they would have a free day.

episodes.title: Franchise Prequel

episodes.title: Hummels & Heroin
episodes.description: Beloved entertainers are being cut down in their prime due to massive overdoses of opiates. Stan is about to be exposed as the source of the illegal drugs.

episodes.title: Splatty Tomato

episodes.title: Dead Kids
episodes.description: With several shooting occurring at South Park Elementary School, Randy attempts to get Sharon to get her emotions in check. Meanwhile, Cartman is mad after realizing he flunked his math quiz, despite copying his answers off Token's quiz.

episodes.title: A Boy and a Priest
episodes.description: A very special relationship has developed between Butters and the Parish Priest. When the town finds the church doors locked and no sign of the pair, they call in the Catholic Church.

episodes.title: The Problem with a Poo

episodes.description: The Vaping epidemic hits South Park Elementary

episodes.title: The Scoots

episodes.description: The boys break out of jail and are on the run from the police and ManBearPig.

episodes.title: Buddha Box
episodes.description: In "Buddha Box," Cartman discovered a foolproof way to tune out the rest of the world and enjoy some quality time on his phone.

episodes.title: Unfulfilled
episodes.description: The citizens of South Park are enjoying all the perks of being a company town when the Amazon Fulfillment Center moves in. Everything is just swell until the contradictions inherent in capitalism threaten to bring the entire system down.

episodes.title: Bike Parade
episodes.description: The Bike Parade is still on, but the boys' chance of winning is in jeopardy when Kenny resists commercialism in solidarity with the Amazon Fulfillment Center's striking workers.

episodes.title: Mexican Joker
episodes.description: Randy fights against home-grown. Meanwhile, Kyle goes to camp.

episodes.title: Band in China
episodes.description: Randy sees an opportunity for Tegridy in China.

episodes.title: Shots!!!
episodes.description: Randy celebrates the success of Tegridy Farms; Cartman refuses to get a shot.

episodes.title: Let Them Eat Goo
episodes.description: The citizens of South Park are moving toward a completely plant-based diet. Cartman is pretty sure the new food in the cafeteria gave him a heart attack.

episodes.title: Tegridy Farms Halloween Special
episodes.description: It's Halloween and Randy is dealing with his daughter's marijuana problem. Butters gets an unexpected surprise when he visits the Egyptian Artifact exhibit at the Denver Museum.

episodes.title: Season Finale
episodes.description: The Mayor has evidence that Randy blew up his neighbor's yards in protest over homegrown weed and then blamed it on a Mexican Joker. Now the citizens of South Park have had enough of Randy and Tegridy Farms and they just want to lock him up.

episodes.title: Board Girls
episodes.description: The annual Strong Woman competition pushes everyone to their limits.

episodes.title: Turd Burglars
episodes.description: Kyle's mom has a fecal transplant and the boys are on a quest for the best microbiome.

episodes.title: Basic Cable
episodes.description: Scott Malkinson's future with the new girl in his class depends on him getting the latest and greatest streaming platform. Scott's dad works for the local cable company and refuses to move beyond basic cable.

episodes.title: Christmas Snow
episodes.description: It's a bleak Christmas Season in South Park this year and it's all Santa's fault. He is single handedly stealing the joy from the holiday. The town just wants their Christmas Spirit back but that will take a Christmas miracle.

episodes.title: Pajama Day
episodes.description: After failing to show respect for their teacher, PC Principal revokes Pajama Day privileges for the entire 4th grade class. Cartman is distraught. The kids aren't going to stand for it but PC Principal refuses to back down.

episodes.title: The Big Fix
episodes.description: Stan's horrified to realize he's misinterpreted some of the greatest writing of all time.

episodes.title: City People
episodes.description: Cartman is furious with his mom when she tells him about her new job.

episodes.title: Back to the Cold War
episodes.description: A lot is riding on Butter's ability to crush the competition in the all-important dressage championship.

episodes.title: Help, My Teenager Hates Me!
episodes.description: The boys find out that the joys of playing Airsoft come with the challenges of dealing with teenagers.

episodes.title: Credigree Weed St. Patrick's Day Special
episodes.description: Butters is shocked to learn that people in South Park don't understand what St. Patrick's Day is really about.

episodes.title: Cupid Ye
episodes.description: Cartman is jealous of the friendship that's developed between Kyle and Tolkien and decides to do something about it.

episodes.title: The World-Wide Privacy Tour
episodes.description: The prince of Canada and his wife try to find privacy and seclusion in a small mountain town.

episodes.title: Japanese Toilet
episodes.description: South Park learns about the wonders of Japanese toilets.

episodes.title: Deep Learning
episodes.description: Stan is reeling when a cheating scandal hits the school.

episodes.title: DiKimble's Hot Dogs
episodes.description: The South Park boys renovate and open an historic restaurant in Colorado.

episodes.title: Spring Break
episodes.description: Spring Break is an excuse for Garrison to jump back into his former depraved lifestyle.

episodes.title: Sermon on the 'Mount
episodes.description: When the residents of South Park face their possible demise, Jesus returns to give them an important message.

episodes.title: Got a Nut

episodes.title: Sickofancy

episodes.title: Wok is Dead
episodes.description: Butters experiences the reality of tariffs when he has to buy a Labubu doll for his girlfriend's birthday.

episodes.title: Conflict of Interest
episodes.description: Kyle and Cartman are at odds when a prediction markets app gets popular with their fellow students.

episodes.title: Twisted Christian
episodes.description: Cartman is possessed and may be the key to stopping the Antichrist.

episodes.title: The Woman in the Hat
episodes.description: The White House deals with a disruptive spirit from the east wing; Stan worries that South Park has become too political.

episodes.title: Sora Not Sorry
episodes.description: Butters' AI revenge plan backfires, igniting an epidemic of fake videos at school that leaves Detective Harris struggling to tell fantasy from reality.

episodes.title: Turkey Trot
episodes.description: The town's annual Turkey Trot turns chaotic when Cartman uses questionable "science" to win the race.

episodes.title: The Crap Out
episodes.description: Satan's due, Stan's praying, and only a Christmas miracle can deliver the Antichrist on time.

episodes.title: South American Biker Gangs
episodes.description: When e-bikes arrive in South America, the boys take over the streets and the parents of South America can hardly recognize South America.

episodes.title: Billionaire Weenietown
episodes.description: Butters is unhappy with the data centers that the billionaires are building in our backyards.

episodes.title: You Like That On Your Face
episodes.description: When aura battles take over South America, Kyle tries to help his little brother not be cringe.

episodes.title: Guinea Pig on a Stick
episodes.description: When South America's beef becomes highly prized and sought after, the four boys fight to keep it in local hands.

episodes.title: We Be Clubbin'
episodes.description: When club sports take over Craig's afternoons and weekends, Tweek signs up to spend more time with him; soon his whole family struggles to keep up.

episodes.title: City Endings
episodes.description: When mysterious power outages strike South America, the townspeople fear Chinese cyberattacks; it's up to the boys to discover what's really going on.

tt4428122.title: Quantico
tt4428122.description: Quantico is about a diverse group of recruits that have arrived at the FBI Quantico Base for training. They are the best, the brightest and the most vetted, so it seems impossible that one of them is suspected of masterminding the biggest attack on New York City since 9/11.

episodes.title: Run
episodes.description: A diverse group of recruits has arrived at the FBI Quantico Base for training. They are the best, the brightest and the most vetted, so it seems impossible that one of them is suspected of masterminding the biggest attack on New York City since 9/11.

episodes.title: America
episodes.description: Alex is on the run and must outsmart Liam and his team to get into her apartment for anything that could help clear her name. Meanwhile, in a flashback to Quantico training, the NATS are tasked with finding a needle in a haystack while looking for potential threats to national security.

episodes.title: Cover
episodes.description: At Quantico, Alex learns of her father's FBI past; and, in the future, Liam asks Alex's mother to take part in a televised press conference geared to getting Alex to turn herself in. In other events, at Quantico, the NATS learn the art of profiling and focus on their classmates' strengths and weaknesses.

episodes.title: Kill
episodes.description: At Quantico, the recruits take part in a hostage rescue training exercise that leaves Alex questioning whether she should quit; and, in the future, she finds possible evidence that seems to point to one of her closest classmates.

episodes.title: Found
episodes.description: The trainees leave campus for the first time while undergoing their first undercover assignment. With an evening full of unpredictable events, Alex and Ryan find themselves getting close while the recruits' skills are tested. In the future, Alex decides to tell her side of the story and sits down for her first public interview leaving everyone watching to wonder who is really telling the truth.

episodes.title: God
episodes.description: The NATs learn surveillance by putting it into practice with Miranda and her troubled son, Charlie. Shelby tries to keep Caleb at a distance, but Raina opens the door to a closer relationship with Simon. In the future, Alex is helped when she tries to hack into an FBI computer.

episodes.title: Go
episodes.description: It's midterm exam time at Quantico where the NATS are given an explosive assignment which results in some people going home for good. In the future, Alex continues to try and clear her name, finding Nimah and Raina who provide more questions than answers leaving Alex and the world to wonder, "who can you really trust?"

episodes.title: Over
episodes.description: In the future, a hack of the FBI computer system causes confidential information to become public; and Alex realizes that a second bomb is in NYC. In other events, at Quantico, the NATs receive individual assignments that are actually connected.

episodes.title: Guilty
episodes.description: At "Quantico," the NATS attend a class with guest speaker Dr. Susan Langdon. Dr. Langdon is a former agent and profiler who tasks the trainees with looking at serial killer cases to find the one victim that doesn't fit the case, but when Simon becomes too good at finding things that don't belong, it's his life that becomes endangered. In the future, Alex is interrogated by a highly sophisticated FBI team while Ryan's life hangs in the balance.

episodes.title: Quantico
episodes.description: At Quantico, an emergency disciplinary hearing causes deep secrets to be spilled, while in the future Alex works covertly with her team to find the real bomber before her time runs out.

episodes.title: Inside
episodes.description: The terrorists behind the Grand Central Station bombing reveal themselves. In other events, at Quantico, the recruits are given time off for the holidays, but not everyone is in a merry mood when secrets are spilled.

episodes.title: Alex
episodes.description: Alex finds herself in the middle of a congressional hearing to testify about the terrorist bombings. Convinced Elias didn't act alone, she is determined to find answers and the truth. While back at Quantico, a new group of NATS join Alex and her classmates, causing tension and competition between the groups of trainees.

episodes.title: Clear
episodes.description: This week the NATS learn how to source information from confidential informants, but when they test their skills in the real world, they soon realize being an agent is not as easy as it seems. Meanwhile, in the future, Alex and a fellow agent find themselves in a life or death situation when they are forced to provide classified information that could result in deadly consequences.

episodes.title: Answer
episodes.description: At Quantico, the NATS team up for defensive driving lessons while tensions between Liam and Drew explode, resulting in shocking admissions and consequences. In the future, Simon grapples with his new reality in the aftermath of what's transpired. Even though his friends try and help him, it's uncertain he will ever be the same again.

episodes.title: Turn
episodes.description: A terror cell tries to infiltrate Quantico, forcing Miranda and Liam to pay a deadly price. While in the future, Alex continues to get instructions from the terrorist - only this time, it's Claire Haas' life that hangs in the balance.

episodes.title: Clue
episodes.description: At Quantico, the NATS are given a training exercise that hits too close to home for Shelby. While in the future, Alex finds an unlikely ally in Hannah, as she continues to try and stop the terrorist from striking again.

episodes.title: Care
episodes.description: At Quantico, the NATS' current assignment is to learn about human trafficking when Liam and Miranda challenge them to cross the U.S. / Canadian border without passports. Meanwhile, in the future, Simon continues to help Alex try to find the terrorist, but doing so puts his own life in great risk.

episodes.title: Soon
episodes.description: At Quantico, the NATs look into each other's background to determine who gets high-level security clearance, and in the process Alex, Shelby and Iris learn some surprising truths about Drew, Will and Caleb. Meanwhile, in the future, Alex contacts Claire Haas in order to find her missing friends and is shocked when she discovers what happened to Caleb.

episodes.title: Fast
episodes.description: It's career day at Quantico as the NATS meet representatives from various FBI branches to help them decide their future paths. In the future, Alex continues to search for the terrorist, and in the process, discovers some familiar faces - including one who knows the terrorist's endgame.

episodes.title: Drive
episodes.description: With only a few weeks until graduation, the NATS are dispatched to various field offices where Alex and Ryan find themselves working a case together. Meanwhile, in the future, Shelby and Caleb's relationship takes a turn, and Alex doesn't know who to trust when she discovers new information about the man she loves.

episodes.title: Right
episodes.description: The NATS are excited that graduation is near as they prepare to leave Quantico and head out into the real world for their new assignments. In the future, Alex learns someone she cared about at Quantico is not who they seemed to be, as she finds herself at the heart of another possible attack.

episodes.title: Yes
episodes.description: It's graduation day for the NATS of Quantico, while, in the future, Alex and her team find themselves head-to-head with the terrorist.

episodes.title: KUDOVE
episodes.description: While investigating the dark world of espionage at a mysterious CIA training facility, Alex becomes caught at the center of a conspiracy that threatens lives across the globe.

episodes.title: LIPSTICK
episodes.description: The new CIA recruits begin running counter-surveillance exercises at The Farm while Alex and Ryan navigate their new relationship with each other. In the future, Ryan and Raina try to disrupt the terrorists' plan to blend in with hostages while trust becomes a deadly weapon, as not everyone is who they seem to be.

episodes.title: STESCALADE
episodes.description: The new CIA recruits continue training at The Farm; in the future, Alex infiltrates the terrorist group holding everyone hostage, and is shocked to learn not everyone is a stranger.

episodes.title: KUBARK
episodes.description: The trainees are put through a training drill that tests their stress levels while Alex tries to gather information and get close to Owen. Meanwhile, in the future, the terrorist organization demands a trade, a move that could possibly end the stand-off.

episodes.title: KMFORGET
episodes.description: At the Farm, Harry is still suspicious of Alex and Ryan, and he's determined to learn more about their plan, while Leon is recruited for a special assignment by Owen. Meanwhile, in the future, Alex continues to run from the terrorists but faces her toughest challenge yet when the terrorists corner her.

episodes.title: AQUILINE
episodes.description: At the Farm, the trainees learn their next task is to decide on a drone strike, which triggers Alex's memories of Simon's sacrifice. Meanwhile, Shelby and Leon's relationship reaches the next level, and Nimah advises Alex and Ryan not to trust Harry. In the future, Alex questions if she can trust Lydia, leading to combat between the two.

episodes.title: LCFLUTTER
episodes.description: At the Farm, Owen teaches the trainees about enhanced interrogation techniques, and turns the tables on his students by putting himself in the hot seat. Meanwhile, Shelby goes undercover. In the future, a new president is sworn in, and Miranda makes a tough choice.

episodes.title: ODENVY
episodes.description: At the Farm, Lydia and Owen teach the group about the necessity of lying and cutting off relationships. Perfect timing for Alex, since she is feeling disconnected from Ryan personally and professionally. In the future, Alex and company attempt to destroy the biological weapon.

episodes.title: CLEOPATRA
episodes.description: The recruits are schooled in the art of seduction, which Alex sees as a perfect opportunity to get closer to Owen, but will it threatens her relationship with Ryan? And in the future, Alex finally gets the answers she's been looking for about who and what the terrorists are on.

episodes.title: JMPALM
episodes.description: At the Farm, Owen teaches the recruits a lesson on the necessity of betrayal, with a mission of getting the Venezuelan Consul Gabriel Carrera to turn on his country. In the future, Alex is forced to team up with Miranda to save the hostages, while President Claire Haas has a plan to end the crisis once and for all.

episodes.title: ZRTORCH
episodes.description: Alex tries to convince Owen of the traitor amongst them. The recruits are tasked with getting an asset out of Germany - but their target has a death wish. In the future, the terrorists resort to new means to gain information from the hostages.

episodes.title: FALLENORACLE
episodes.description: At the Farm, the recruits break into the NSA on a mission to delete all their personal information, but the rogue group within the CIA has other plans. In the future, the hostages strategize an escape via underground tunnels as a set-up to get the terrorists to reveal themselves.

episodes.title: EPICSHELTER
episodes.description: The recruits learn how to burn everything down if they are ever exposed. Meanwhile, a mysterious death leads to an FBI investigation at the Farm. In the future, Alex heads back into the crisis zone and exposes the true traitor within the CIA.

episodes.title: LNWILT
episodes.description: In the wake of the G20 hostage crisis, President Claire Haas assembles an illegal and clandestine joint task force, bringing together Alex and her friends from both the FBI and CIA to unmask a global conspiracy.

episodes.title: MOCKINGBIRD
episodes.description: While their newly appointed leader gets familiar with the team of CIA and FBI agents, Owen leads an investigation into the strange world of fake news. But hunting down the publishers of a fake story might lead to deadly consequences.

episodes.title: MKTOPAZ
episodes.description: When Clay is forced to use his fiancée to carry out an operation, the whole team reexamines their personal connections, or more accurately, the lack thereof. Meanwhile, Alex forges an unexpected bond with an asset at the center of a conspiracy, and Harry struggles to find his place on the task force.

episodes.title: ODYOKE
episodes.description: When one of Alex's friends is framed for a domestic terror attack, they turn to her for help. With an upcoming vote in the House for a Muslim registry bill, the task force realizes this attack isn't a coincidence. The Collaborators are actively stirring fear to pass the registry, and our team heads to the Hill to turn the votes. Meanwhile, Alex and Owen track down an assassin.

episodes.title: KUMONK
episodes.description: A despondent Clay meets with the President to discuss the future of the task force, but he's interrupted by the arrival of his brother. Meanwhile, Alex leads an operation to expose the collaborators' plans to sink the President's reputation, and she teaches Owen to trust his instincts.

episodes.title: MHORDER
episodes.description: With all the collaborators unveiled, the team uses Clay and Maxine's engagement party to entice them into one place. The mission: turn one against the others. But everyone's lives are put at risk when one member of the team makes a surprising decision.

episodes.title: GLOBALREACH
episodes.description: Risking it all, Alex works with Owen to infiltrate the Collaborators. When they begin to test her loyalty, Alex realizes she's become a pawn in their plan to take down both the President and the task force.

episodes.title: RAINBOW
episodes.description: After an impossible choice is made, a flood of new proposals shine a light on the final stages of the Collaborators' plan. Fractured but not defeated, the task force, with the help of some old friends, work to put the pieces together before the Collaborators can enact an unthinkable terrorist attack.

episodes.title: RESISTANCE
episodes.description: In the Season 2 finale, Alex and the team make a last stand against the Collaborators at the Constitutional Convention, where a new amendment to the Constitution threatens every American's freedom.

episodes.title: The Conscience Code
episodes.description: Ryan and Alex recruit Owen and Harry to help rescue their friend and defeat the villain. To help the cause, Owen brings in former agent Jocelyn Turner, who has her own dark past with The Widow. A whole new future lies ahead for this team when they agree to work together as an elite black-ops task force and the thrilling, heart-stopping adventures continue.

episodes.title: Fear and Flesh
episodes.description: In tracking down the origin of a deadly strain of tuberculosis threatening Americans, Agent Ryan Booth must go undercover and infiltrate a white supremacist organization - an assignment that threatens the life of another member of the team.

episodes.title: Hell's Gate
episodes.description: The team must protect an ex-CIA agent to take down a cartel kingpin, an assignment that puts all of their lives in danger.

episodes.title: Spy Games
episodes.description: Alex and McQuigg are assigned to protect a prince following the assassination of an emir – but the team soon realizes the killer is closer than they think.

episodes.title: The Blood of Romeo
episodes.description: When a physics professor at a major U.S. university steals weaponized uranium, the team scrambles to find the professor and the missing uranium before it can be used against an important international summit meeting in New York City.

episodes.title: Heaven's Fall
episodes.description: Jocelyn shares her very personal story of hearing loss when she finds herself face-to-face with the adversary responsible for the bomb explosion that changed her life forever. Meanwhile, the team works together to take him down and infiltrates an illegal, underground operation that has deadly consequences when not everyone comes out alive.

episodes.title: Bullet Train
episodes.description: The team is tasked with protecting a scientist who has developed a deadly technology that, in the wrong hands, could have devastating consequences to mankind. Meanwhile, Ryan and Shelby stumble on something personal of Alex's that signals a possible change in her personal life.

episodes.title: Deep Cover
episodes.description: Alex goes undercover with an American military contractor who is believed to have struck a deadly deal with another country; but in the end, it's Alex's life that's on the line.

episodes.title: Fear Feargach
episodes.description: Lives are in danger as the team protects Shelby when she reunites with someone from her past, resulting in deadly consequences.

episodes.title: No Place Is Home
episodes.description: When Owen and McQuigg learn heartbreaking news about family members, the team goes on high alert as they quickly learn nowhere is safe.

episodes.title: The Art of War
episodes.description: Conor Devlin has plans of his own when he plots revenge and returns to his home country, Ireland; meanwhile, the team unknowingly finds themselves as a pawn in his plans.

episodes.title: Ghosts
episodes.description: Conor Devlin continues to seek revenge as someone from Alex's past comes back into her life.

episodes.title: Who Are You?
episodes.description: The team is in Ireland, and when they finally come face-to-face with Conor Devlin, not everyone comes out alive. And Alex makes a life-changing decision about her future.

tt0096657.title: Mr. Bean
tt0096657.description: The first episode of the original Mr. Bean series starring Rowan Atkinson was first broadcast on 1st January 1990. Since then Mr. Bean has become known all over the world. Created by Rowan Atkinson, Richard Curtis and Robin Driscoll, there were only 14 episodes ever made. The original series emerged from Rowan Atkinson's stage revues of the 1980′s which featured the silent odd-ball. Rowan Atkinson's comic acting genius has created a highly original work for television. The Mr. Bean series has been sold to 190 territories worldwide and has won an International Emmy and the Golden Rose of Montreux.

episodes.title: Mr. Bean
episodes.description: Mr. Bean takes an exam, sunbathes and goes to church with Richard Briers - driving badly all the way!

episodes.title: The Return of Mr. Bean
episodes.description: In this edition, Mr. Bean visits a department store and gets carried away.

episodes.title: The Curse of Mr. Bean
episodes.description: Mr. Bean demonstrates diving and sandwich-making.

episodes.title: Mr. Bean Goes to Town
episodes.description: In this escapade, Mr. Bean buys a TV and a new camera, has an itchy foot and goes on a date.

episodes.title: The Trouble with Mr. Bean
episodes.description: Thanks to some ingenious driving, Mr. Bean gets to an appointment with the dentist after oversleeping. He also has trouble in the park with a bothersome wasp, and meets a child with a remote-controlled boat.

episodes.title: Mr. Bean Rides Again
episodes.description: Mr. Bean comes to the aid of a heart-attack victim, fails miserably to post a letter and flies off on holiday.

episodes.title: Merry Christmas Mr. Bean
episodes.description: Mr. Bean wreaks havoc at Harrods when he goes Christmas shopping, then has trouble stuffing a turkey on Christmas Day.

episodes.title: Mr. Bean in Room 426
episodes.description: Mr. Bean books into a hotel room and makes himself well and truly at home. In typical fashion he manages to lock himself out in a state of undress. Fortunately, help comes from an unexpected saviour.

episodes.title: Do-It-Yourself Mr. Bean
episodes.description: Mr. Bean catches a bargain in the New Year's Day sales, devises an unusual method of transporting his shopping home and wreaks havoc by doing a spot of decorating.

episodes.title: Mind the Baby, Mr. Bean
episodes.description: Mr Bean at the funfair with a baby...

episodes.title: Back to School Mr. Bean
episodes.description: Mr. Bean visits a local school's open day, trying out some painting, a spot of judo, and goods from the cake stall.

episodes.title: Tee Off, Mr. Bean
episodes.description: Mr. Bean misplaces his trousers at the laundromat; Mr. Bean is challenged at the Krazy Golf Course.

episodes.title: Goodnight, Mr. Bean
episodes.description: More mayhem with hapless bumbler Mr. Bean as he thinks up some unusual methods to help him sleep.

episodes.title: Hair by Mr. Bean of London
episodes.description: The blunderingly inept master of disaster goes for a haircut, but ends up styling the other customers' hair before causing chaos at a school fun day.

tt13640670.title: Man vs Bee
tt13640670.description: A man finds himself at war with a bee while housesitting a luxurious mansion. Who will win, and what irreparable damage will be done in the process?

episodes.title: Chapter 1
episodes.description: Doting dad Trevor Bingley arrives at a couple's lavish home to house-sit while they're away. A bee follows closely behind — and the battle begins.

episodes.title: Chapter 2
episodes.description: Trevor tries to remember the codes to unlock the library and prevent further damage. Later, he must reschedule upcoming plans with his daughter.

episodes.title: Chapter 3
episodes.description: A police officer checks in on things. Cupcake ruins her prescription dog diet with peanut butter. Trevor releases the bee outside — but not for long.

episodes.title: Chapter 4
episodes.description: With Cupcake's help, Trevor finds a messy way back inside and deals major damage with a kitchen hand mixer before the police officer arrives again.

episodes.title: Chapter 5
episodes.description: Trevor cleans up with a shower under flashy lights and a groovy soundtrack. Later, the bee leads Trevor to the couple's grand piano.

episodes.title: Chapter 6
episodes.description: Trevor tries to repair more damaged art. After chatting with Maddy, Trevor becomes too preoccupied with the bee to notice art burglars have broken in.

episodes.title: Chapter 7
episodes.description: The burglars reveal themselves at an opportune time. Trevor must take Cupcake to the vet after his bee trap doesn't go as planned.

episodes.title: Chapter 8
episodes.description: Trevor gets behind the wheel of Christian's expensive car to head to the vet. Later, a desperate Trevor devises a way to get rid of the bee for good.

episodes.title: Chapter 9
episodes.description: With Nina and Christian on their way back home, Trevor goes in pursuit of his unrelenting rival with blazing fury.

tt0280277.title: Mr. Bean
tt0280277.description: A clueless yet clever loner bungles his way through life in London.

episodes.title: In the Wild
episodes.description: Upon watching a wildlife photographer taking pictures of the wilderness on TV, Mr. Bean decides to become a wildlife photographer himself, but his attempts to photograph the animals mostly fail. In order for the animals to not elude him, he disguises as a fox but a group of dogs mistakes Bean as a real fox and chases him to his apartment.

episodes.title: Missing Teddy
episodes.description: Teddy gets stolen by a duo of burglars who manage to steal every teddy bear around London. To save him, Mr. Bean tracks down and thwarts the burglars, retrieves Teddy and returns the rest of the teddy bears to their owners.

episodes.title: No Parking
episodes.description: Mr. Bean's tries to find a parking spot so that he can watch a new movie with little success.

episodes.title: Bean's Bounty
episodes.description: Whilst digging for treasure, Mr. Bean builds his own metal detector and goes to hunt for treasure, but fails. When he finally manages to find treasure and brings it to his flat, the burglar duo follow him and tie him up but Mrs. Wicket confronts them and the police arrive, arresting the duo once again. However, Mrs. Wicket and Scrapper also get arrested as Mrs. Wicket's mud mask looks like a thief's mask.

episodes.title: Mime Games
episodes.description: Because he fails to pay a street mime in the park, the mime follows Mr. Bean when he isn't looking and breaks Mrs. Wicket's water statue. Eventually, Bean out-mimes him, kidnaps the man disguising as a silver statue and uses him to replace the broken water statue.

episodes.title: Spring Clean
episodes.description: It is spring cleaning time and Mr. Bean's flat is a total mess, so he cleans up everything. After this, he takes a bath, but after he gets out of the tub, he accidentally slips on the soap and slams into the vacuum, causing it to explode and thus his flat becomes dirty again. He tries to bathe again, but since there is no more hot water, he tries stealing some from a neighbour but some green shampoo causes him to become green. Finally, Bean attempts to take a bath in Mrs. Wicket's bath tub while she is in town, but puts too much washing powder in the machine, causing it to explode and fill the entire apartment building with water bubbles.

episodes.title: Birthday Bear
episodes.description: On Teddy's birthday, Mr. Bean decides to invite his girlfriend Irma Gobb to Teddy's birthday party at night. However, Irma becomes unhappy and uncomfortable at the party due to Bean's unfair play. When it is 9:00, Bean shows Irma a fireworks display and she feels better.

episodes.title: The Mole
episodes.description: Mrs. Wicket's croquet game is interrupted by an offending mole. Mr. Bean tries to get rid of it, but to no avail until he finally manages to capture it. Mrs. Wicket then orders Bean to kill it with a croquet hammer, but Bean, having mercy not to kill it, puts it into a jar and releases it into the wild.

episodes.title: Roadworks
episodes.description: Mr. Bean tries to relax, but the roadworks outside are making too much noise and shaking his whole flat. After numerous failed attempts to interrupt the workers, he finally delays them by offering them food but fails to notice steam from a cracked pipe. When Bean lights the candle in his cart of food for the workers even though they tell him not to, the pipe then explodes, causing Bean to end up in the hospital.

episodes.title: The Sofa
episodes.description: While watching TV with Teddy, Mr. Bean finds the remote inside the sofa, resulting in lots of springs coming out of his sofa; he plans to buy a new sofa, but cannot afford the cost of £300.
